sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.description:
Use this tool to create an official Fraud Case on the sn_bom_fraud_case table with the Service Definition 'Report Fraud via Voice AI'.
When to call: - Call this tool when the customer confirms an unauthorized charge, compromised card, or fraudulent transaction on their account.
Inputs to provide: - 'financial_account_sys_id': Pass the Sys ID of the selected account from 'selected_account_sys_id'. - 'transaction_sys_id': (Optional) Pass the Sys ID of the disputed transaction if identified during transaction review. - 'disputed_amount': Pass the amount of the unauthorized charge (e.g. 898.75). - 'fraud_reason': State the caller's reason (e.g. "Customer reports unauthorized online purchase"). - 'card_blocked': Set to true to apply immediate temporary restriction on the card.
Outputs & Context: - Store the returned 'case_sys_id' in conversation context for the confirmation email tool. - Inform the caller of their case number (e.g. FRC0001030) and confirm that a security block has been placed on their card.
sn_aia_agent_tool_m2m.name: Create Fraud Case
